newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer against South Africa's rand but closed weaker versus other hard currencies on the back of slight import pressure on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The local dollar lost a cent in the morning on the back of importer demand and traded there for quite a while," a dealer said.
"The Reserve Bank didn't come in but someone in the market received some money which they started selling and we went up a bit."
He said the local unit finished the day at 10.6800/7000 against the U.S. dollar, slightly better than 10.6850/7050 in the morning but weaker compared to 10.6750/6950 overnight.
Against pound sterling it closed at 17.9080/9520 from 17.8700/9140 and was also quoted easier on the mark at 7.1240/1420 from 7.1000/1150 the previous day.
The Zimbabwe dollar however registered marginal gains on the rand at 2.2920/2990 from 2.2990/3070.
